subject: CSA control fidelity review and supplemental evidence handoff
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex@stormgrid.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CSA control fidelity — request for deeper artifacts

Karthik — thanks for the initial CAIQ crosswalk you shared last week. StormGrid's security team did a quick pass and asked for a short follow-up so we can close the control set for procurement. They want: 

- A short "control fidelity" note for the following controls: CSA-NW-04 (network segmentation), CSA-LOG-02 (runtime telemetry), CSA-KEY-01 (key rotation/assertion). We need concrete evidence snippets (log samples, retention policy statements, timeline of rotation events).
- An explicit mapping row showing which runtime component produces each telemetry artifact (e.g., inference-gateway, batch-aggregator, cache-proxy).
- A signed access agreement for our security team to pull a limited telemetry bundle for validation.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver (a) a control-mapping spreadsheet with the requested fidelity, (b) a telemetry sample bundle (anonymized), and (c) a one-page key-rotation proof? Timing: StormGrid would like this before their review on Wednesday 30 Jun.

Appreciate a short plan & owner assignment.

— Alex
Security & Procurement, StormGrid Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@stormgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA control fidelity — request for deeper artifacts

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the three items you listed. Quick plan and owners: 

- Control fidelity spreadsheet (owner: Kimberly Park) — will add a per-control "evidence pointer" column with source component, artifact type, and sample filename. Will attach a v2 spreadsheet by EOD Monday.
- Telemetry sample bundle (owner: Marcus Lin / Observability) — we will prepare a time-boxed, redacted bundle from inference-gateway and runtime-aggregator (no customer input). Expect a zip with sample logs and a README describing fields. Delivery target: Tue 29 Jun morning.
- Key rotation proof (owner: Marissa Cole) — single-page summary of rotation cadence, KMS usage, and audit entries. We'll include a small text proof file with hashed rotation event IDs. Delivery target: Tue 29 Jun by EOD.

On the access agreement: we can provide a short access agreement for StormGrid to sign (limits scope / retention / destruction). I will attach a draft DocuSign link once legal gives the green light — should be ready Monday.

In the meantime, I'm attaching an interim control map (attached) with preliminary fidelity notes so your reviewers have something to look at. Kimberly — can you fill column C (evidence pointer) and column F (control owner) and return by Monday? Marcus — please confirm the telemetry export window and redaction plan. Marissa — will you draft the one-pager after I loop legal in?

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: csa_control_map_v2.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Reynolds <alex@stormgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA control fidelity — request for deeper artifacts

Thanks Karthik — I updated the spreadsheet with evidence pointers and short fidelity notes. Highlights: 

- CSA-NW-04 (network segmentation): evidence = VPC/subnet mapping export (artifact name: vpc-subnet-map-202706.zip), control owner = infra-team. Note calls out service-to-service ACLs and host-based firewall gating for the inference caching tier.
- CSA-LOG-02 (runtime telemetry): evidence = runtime-telemetry-sample-20270627.zip (contains aggregated request traces, per-route latency histograms, and KV cache hit-rate events). Redacted PII, includes README describing redaction.
- CSA-KEY-01 (key rotation): evidence = key-rotation-evidence.txt (contains rotation timestamps, key IDs, and hashed audit entry references). Rotation cadence is 90 days for symmetric keys, older asymmetric keys rotated per policy.

I've attached the updated mapping and included an extra column listing the exact component that emits each log line (e.g., inference-gateway.v1.4, batch-aggregator.v2). Alex — you'll see an explicit row that ties the "kv-cache-miss" metric to cache-proxy logs.

Marcus — can you confirm the telemetry bundle will be ready for delivery to Alex on Tue morning? Also, we should include a short note on retention windows (we hold telemetry in hot storage for 14 days, archive for 180 days).

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-sample-20270627.zip, key-rotation-evidence.txt

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex@stormgrid.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA control fidelity — request for deeper artifacts

Alex — telemetry bundle has been uploaded to the shared drive and we delivered a short README inside the zip describing field-level redactions and PSK redaction for API keys. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/SG-2027-44/runtime-telemetry-sample-20270627.zip

Notes for reviewers: 
- Export window: 2027-06-20 00:00:00 to 2027-06-20 23:59:59 UTC (24h sample).
- Redaction: user identifiers replaced with hashed IDs; no request payloads included.
- Provenance: each log file includes a header with hostname, component version, and a signed HMAC per file to validate delivery integrity.

Marissa has uploaded the key-rotation text proof and Karthik's team has prepared the access agreement draft (DocuSign). Alex — can you confirm the StormGrid security reviewer who will accept the bundle and we'll send the DocuSign envelope to contracts@stormgrid.com.

Marcus Lin
Observability Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: access-agreement-stormgrid.pdf (DocuSign pending)

On Thu, Jul 1, 2027 at 16:45, Alex Reynolds <alex@stormgrid.com> wrote:
> Thanks — confirmed receipt of the telemetry zip and the key-rotation proof. I'll route the access agreement to our contracts team (contracts@stormgrid.com) and ask our security reviewer, Emily Carter, to validate the sample by EOD Friday. If everything looks good we'll mark CSA items closed and proceed with procurement.
>
> Appreciate the fast turnaround from your team.
>
> — Alex
> Security & Procurement, StormGrid Systems
